profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Go & Java | Distributed Systems, Kubernetes & Storage | Video & AI Infrastructure
profile.summary:
I’m a hands-on Senior Staff Software Engineer building distributed systems in Java and Go, from application backends to Kubernetes-native infrastructure, storage, and real-time video platforms.
As the first developer on Blaize AI Studio, I helped establish its architecture and engineering foundations and remain a core contributor to its Java/Spring, MongoDB, and RabbitMQ platform. My work includes DSFS, a dataset storage system adopted internally for AI training and company projects; a device plugin used across all Blaize Kubernetes-based projects; and operators for workflows, databases, and full-platform deployment.
I also architected and led development of Blaize Media Plane, evolving STM from a standalone stream manager into an edge-to-cloud platform for video streaming, recording, and distributed AI analytics. It supports frame-synchronized AI metadata, searchable video archives, and autonomous edge operation. STM is currently being integrated into Blaize’s video analytics solutions.
Previously, at Deutsche Bank, I developed Java components for GBA, which processes hundreds of thousands of trades daily across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. I received an award for inventing a Cucumber-based testing framework with an embedded visual debugger that significantly improved the US engineering team’s productivity.
I combine hands-on architecture and implementation with technical leadership, mentoring, and a focus on practical adoption. Since 2022, I have managed the engineer responsible for the developer infrastructure and DevOps environment I established at Blaize.
Based in Wake Forest, North Carolina. U.S. citizen. Open to senior and staff-level software engineering opportunities in the Research Triangle and remotely across the United States.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
First developer on Blaize AI Studio; established its initial architecture and codebase and remain a core contributor (Go, Java, Spring Framework, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, React). Progressed from Senior to Staff to Senior Staff Software Engineer.
• Invented DSFS in Go, adopted internally for AI-training dataset storage and company projects: S3-backed content-addressed storage, deduplication, index-based versioning, read-only POSIX FUSE, fast import/export, and Kubernetes CSI.
• Architected and led Blaize Media Plane, evolving STM into an edge-to-cloud video, recording, and AI analytics platform. Enabled distributed inference, independently identifiable metadata tracks, low-latency frame-synchronized overlays, searchable archives, and retrospective analytics. STM is being integrated into Blaize video analytics solutions. Defined HA and workload-distribution designs targeting up to one million streams.
• Built Blaize’s Go device plugin for GSP accelerators, used in all Kubernetes-based company projects.
• Architected and implemented Process Manager (Go/Kubebuilder) for multi-step workflows using DSFS for data exchange; built separate MongoDB and Redis lifecycle operators.
• Built the full AI Studio deployment operator for Blaize AI Racks, adapting databases, ingress, storage, identity, and video to cluster resources, with an embedded AI agent guiding less experienced users.
• Created EdgeProxy (Go/gRPC) for access behind NAT/firewalls and an on-premises OAuth2/OIDC/JWT auth server.
• Established the NC datacenter, Kubernetes developer platform, SDLC, and CI/CD. Since 2022, manage one direct report responsible for daily infrastructure and DevOps operations.
Engineering practices: Prometheus-compatible metrics across components; AI-assisted development guided by specifications, tests, reviews, and verification.
positions.insights: Skills: Distributed File Systems · gRPC · Webrtc · MongoDB · RabbitMQ · Live Video Streaming · HTTP Live Streaming

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Java components for Global Booking and Allocating (GBA), an asynchronous, low-latency, in-memory platform processing hundreds of thousands of trades daily across the Americas, Europe, and Asia.
• Migrated Tracer functionality into GBA, contributing across architecture, implementation, testing, and delivery.
• Received an award for inventing a Cucumber-based testing framework with an embedded visual debugger that significantly increased the US engineering team’s productivity.
Focus: Java, distributed systems, asynchronous processing, low-latency software, trade processing, and automated testing.

positions.title: Lead Java Developer
positions.description:
Lead Java Developer on the Deutsche Bank account. Relocated from Moscow to Cary, NC in September 2013, continuing the same client engagement without a break.
Highlights across the Luxoft / Deutsche Bank engagement (2010–2017):
• Developed distributed trade-capture, order-management, and financial integration systems in Java.
• Designed a reusable trade-matching API and algorithm adopted across GBA modules; improved legacy Tracer performance and reliability during migration.
• Implemented rules-driven Auto IOI matching and redesigned TradeConnect monitoring and ICE market-data integration.
• Built federated search and automated deployment for a financial portal spanning 40+ production servers in the US, UK, and Singapore.
Focus: Java, Spring Framework, distributed systems, financial messaging, trade processing, and integration.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
Senior Java Developer on the Deutsche Bank account, contributing to the Finance Portal, Order Management System, and Commodities AS projects.
• Developed Java/Spring enterprise applications, order-management functionality, and financial integrations using FIX, JMS, and relational databases.
• Contributed to ongoing delivery, refactoring, and integration across portal and trading systems.
Technologies: Java, Spring Framework, Hibernate/JPA, JMS, FIX/QuickFIX/J, Drools, Liferay, Alfresco, Oracle, Sybase, JavaScript, and Unix shell scripting.
Relocated to Cary, NC in September 2013 to continue the same Deutsche Bank engagement through Luxoft USA. Consolidated engagement achievements are listed under Luxoft USA.

positions.title: Head of software development department
positions.description:
Led four engineers developing the Social Card for Moscow Citizens issuance and transaction platform, holding 12M+ cards and 2B+ transactions and processing 150M–200M transactions monthly.
• Combined team leadership and project delivery with hands-on Java enterprise architecture and software development.
• Owned planning, delivery, acceptance testing, mentoring, and hiring.
• Created a business-process engine with graphical notation and a development IDE, using Swing, JGraph, Groovy, Drools, and Spring.
• Designed an event-driven entity lifecycle framework to manage entity behavior according to its state.
• Built JSquib, an Ajax UI framework based on the Model-View-Presenter pattern.
Technologies: Java, Spring Framework, Hibernate, Oracle, EJB, Drools, Groovy, Swing, and JavaScript.

positions.title: Project Manager, J2EE Architect, Application Developer
positions.description:
System design engineering, Software development, Project management

Used skills: J2EE, EJB, Oracle ADF+BC, Oracle DBMS 10g, JSP, SAP tRFC, Mainframe integration with termcap

positions.description:
Responsibilities:

- Project management. 
- Software development in key areas (own web-application server and some frameworks)

Used skills: J2EE, Servlets, Multithreading, Object pooling, Integration, Runtime classloading, Network protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP, SSL, Telnet, SMTP), HTML, JNDI SPI API, JCA, JAAS, J2EE Patterns, UML
